stem: Which factor contributed to the population shift described in this excerpt?

options.label: A
options.text: The granting of citizenship to American Indians

visual_elements: White settlers from the East poured across the Mississippi to mine, farm, and ranch. African-American settlers also came West from the Deep South, convinced by promoters of all-black Western towns that prosperity could be found there. Chinese . . . workers further added to the diversity of the region’s population.
—"The American West, 1865-1900," Library of Congress, www.loc.gov (accessed November 19, 2018)
